title: Reminders
usage: For example: /remind 10m tea, /remind 18:30 call mom, /remind tomorrow 9:00 dentist, /remind 25.12 gifts
error.when: Could not tell when to remind.
delete.title: Delete the reminder?
delete.scheduled: The message scheduled in Saved Messages stays: delete it there if you don't need it.
input.title: Remind me
input.about: When and what. For example: 10m tea, 18:30 call mom, tomorrow 9:00 dentist.
input.about_message: When? For example: 10m, 18:30, tomorrow 9:00. Text after the time replaces the message text.
settings.empty.about: Type /remind 10m tea in any chat: the command is not sent.
settings.tap: Tap a reminder to delete it. /reminders in any chat shows the list too.
settings.saved.about: "Write at the time" sends the reminder to Saved Messages when it is due, if fuckgram is running. "Schedule in Telegram" puts a scheduled message there at once: Telegram delivers it even when fuckgram is closed, on all your devices.
settings.morning: Hour for a day without a time
settings.commands: /remind 10m, 1h30m, in 2 hours, 18:30, 6pm, today 21:00, tomorrow 9:00, 25.12 10:00 and the text. /reminders shows the list. Russian forms work too: /напомни через час, завтра в 9.
